headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 18, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays secured a thrilling 4-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Nathan Lukes leading the offense. The Cleveland Guardians took down the Milwaukee Brewers 4-2, thanks to Parker Messick's strong performance. The Minnesota Twins dominated the Texas Rangers 9-3, with Trevor Larnach hitting three home runs and Joe Ryan pitching five strong innings.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Mike Trout has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain with the Los Angeles Angels. Everson Pereira is on the 7-day injured list with a concussion for the Chicago White Sox. Cole Ragans has been moved to the 60-day injured list with left elbow impingement for the Kansas City Royals.

The MLB trade market has been active, with several notable moves. Hunter Stratton has been traded to the Pittsburgh Pirates from the Atlanta Braves in exchange for catcher Joey Bart. The Kansas City Royals acquired right-handed pitcher Randy Dobnak from the Seattle Mariners for cash. The Los Angeles Angels traded for catcher Tyler Heineman from the Toronto Blue Jays, and the Toronto Blue Jays also acquired right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold from the Kansas City Royals.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Red Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, finalizing the score at 4-3. Nathan Lukes led the Blue Jays' offense with a home run and one RBI.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Brewers 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 4-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Parker Messick earning the win after 6.0 innings of work.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Rangers 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 9-3 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Trevor Larnach leading the offense and Joe Ryan dominating on the mound. Larnach hit 3 home runs, drove in 3 runs, and went 5 for 5 at the plate, while Ryan pitched 5 strong innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Down Orioles in Shutout Victory**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 3-0 win over the Baltimore Orioles, with Bryan Woo pitching 7.0 innings, striking out 9 and allowing 0 earned runs. Andrés Muñoz earned the save in the shutout victory.

top_news.title: **Trout Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels center fielder Mike Trout has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain.

top_news.title: **Stratton Heads to Pittsburgh in Trade**
top_news.summary: Hunter Stratton, a right-handed pitcher, has been traded to the Pittsburgh Pirates. The move comes after the Atlanta Braves dealt Stratton to the Pirates in exchange for catcher Joey Bart.
